_: Creature states (Ed, 2026-10-05; issue #87). wild: the default (attacks the witch in or near its area, and her posse; ignores happy and enraged ones). happy: invited (attacks only the enraged; defends its own area against sieges, dances in it once it has a soundsystem; never enraged). leashed: invited again, on her sigil stack or at a sigil (attacks the wild and the enraged). enraged: a wave put a soundsystem in its area (attacks the witch, the happy and the leashed; besieges the nearest soundsystem; can't be invited and blocks 💌s). No creature ever attacks its own kind. A knocked-down wild creature lies dazed for tuning combat.daze seconds (nothing attacks it; it can still be invited) before it runs off; any other knocked down runs off at once. affection (the 💌 invite meter): hits a full meter takes at each level (baby, young, adult; a legend can't be invited), the share of a full meter that drains each second once hits stop (after drainDelay seconds), and gap: at most one 💌 counts on a creature every gap seconds (stacked shots don't invite one faster). leash: how a happy creature becomes leashed: 'pickup' (Ed, 2026-10-06: its 💌 ring full, its sigil pops out and lies as a rune at its feet, moving with it; she stands within leash.pickRadius of it on the ground and presses E, and it joins the bottom of her stack, leashed; pickupDelay: seconds after the hearts before the rune is ready), 'again' (the old way, kept to compare: a second meter, filled the same way) or 'hold' (hold the invite button on it for holdTime seconds). Only happy legends (and legends) have no rune. Until the 💌s land, the old proximity chat does the same: a completed chat makes a wild one happy, and a second one leashes it.
